article.title: TikTok第四季更新：成本與素材控制
article.title_en: TikTok’s Q4 preview expands cost and creative controls
article.summary: TikTok於10月30日公布第四季產品更新，介紹GMV Max Pro、Growth Autopilot及Smart+素材選擇新安排，並擴充搜尋廣告診斷及關鍵字建議。
article.summary_en: TikTok’s October 30 Q4 preview introduces GMV Max Pro, Growth Autopilot and Smart+ creative-selection options alongside search diagnostics and keyword recommendations.
article.why: 電商團隊可用較完整成本檢視投放，創意團隊亦要明確選擇素材加入與審批方式。
article.why_en: Commerce teams can assess ads against broader costs, while creative teams should deliberately choose how recommended assets enter campaigns.

article.next_step_en: Confirm market and account eligibility, reconcile cost definitions and ROI targets, and select a review-before-launch creative workflow.
highlights: GMV Max Pro把優惠券、聯盟及平台佣金等成本納入優化；Growth Autopilot可設定7日ROI目標，結合廣告與優惠券預算。
Smart+可自動加入建議素材、先審核批准，或固定素材；搜尋新增展示佔有率及每日更新的關鍵字組合建議。
highlights_en: GMV Max Pro includes coupon, affiliate and commission costs; Growth Autopilot combines ad and coupon budgets toward a seven-day ROI target.
Smart+ offers automatic additions, review before launch or a fixed selection; search gains impression-share diagnostics and daily-refreshed keyword packs.
article.detail:
TikTok於10月30日公布第四季產品更新，介紹GMV Max Pro、Growth Autopilot及Smart+素材選擇新安排，並擴充搜尋廣告診斷及關鍵字建議。

GMV Max Pro把優惠券、聯盟及平台佣金等成本納入優化；Growth Autopilot可設定7日ROI目標，結合廣告與優惠券預算。

Smart+可自動加入建議素材、先審核批准，或固定素材；搜尋新增展示佔有率及每日更新的關鍵字組合建議。

電商團隊可用較完整成本檢視投放，創意團隊亦要明確選擇素材加入與審批方式。

向平台確認市場與帳戶資格，先核對成本口徑及ROI目標，再選擇先審後投的素材流程。

產品預覽未逐項列出香港或全部市場資格；ROI是優化目標，並非保證達標。功能與效果按平台公告歸因。
article.detail_en:
TikTok’s October 30 Q4 preview introduces GMV Max Pro, Growth Autopilot and Smart+ creative-selection options alongside search diagnostics and keyword recommendations.

GMV Max Pro includes coupon, affiliate and commission costs; Growth Autopilot combines ad and coupon budgets toward a seven-day ROI target.

Smart+ offers automatic additions, review before launch or a fixed selection; search gains impression-share diagnostics and daily-refreshed keyword packs.

Commerce teams can assess ads against broader costs, while creative teams should deliberately choose how recommended assets enter campaigns.

Confirm market and account eligibility, reconcile cost definitions and ROI targets, and select a review-before-launch creative workflow.

The preview does not establish Hong Kong or universal market eligibility. ROI is an optimization target, not a guaranteed result; capabilities are attributed to TikTok.
